subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration URLs in the dashboard, and what exact URL/button trust contract should that public skill metadata use?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but the permanent decision is whether arbitrary skill metadata may create actionable dashboard links and whether that belongs in SKILL.md, Skill Cards, ClawHub metadata, or a broader plugin settings contract.

options.title: Adopt a typed config action
options.body: Add a narrow `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with validated URL semantics, safe default button text, docs, and tests across parser, gateway status, protocol/UI types, and the Skills page.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub metadata as the only link surfaces until there is evidence that a dedicated Configure action is materially different.

options.title: Defer to plugin settings design
options.body: Hold this issue open or close it after a maintainer decision if configuration UIs should be owned by a future plugin settings surface instead of skill frontmatter.

recommendation.title: Adopt a typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with validated URL semantics, safe default button text, docs, and tests across parser, gateway status, protocol/UI types, and the Skills page.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent URL-helper work place steipete closest to both the Skills UI path and the dashboard URL trust policy.
